purpose: Govern the accessibility of GSSC client-facing documents, and state honestly and in one place what is currently guaranteed and what is not.
human_note: This module exists because nothing else did. Modules 01-18 govern type, colour, geometry, overflow, governance and collision, and none of them said anything about whether a document can be read by a screen reader.

current_state.source_floor: ENFORCED. A declared document language, a non-empty title, a text alternative on every image, and a label or explicit aria-hidden on every figure. Checked on every run by Section 45 and demonstrated to fail on fixtures missing lang and missing alt.
current_state.pdf_structure: NOT GUARANTEED, AND DISCLOSED. The approved print workflow (Chrome/Edge, Ctrl+P, A4, margins none, background graphics on, 100%, Save as PDF) emits an UNTAGGED PDF by construction: no structure tree, no tagged table headers, no explicit reading order. Every GSSC PDF released to date is in this state.
current_state.why_not_closed: No tool capable of writing PDF structure exists in the operating environment -- re-confirmed 2026-09-22 alongside the rendering-engine check: no Chromium, no Playwright, no WeasyPrint, no wkhtmltopdf, no Prince, no pagedjs-cli, and no working package installer. LibreOffice is present and is already disqualified as a conversion path by Module 10. Claiming conformance without a tool that can produce it would be the exact failure class 2.16.0 was written to end.

commercial_relevance: PDF/UA or WCAG 2.1 AA conformance appears as boilerplate in an increasing share of institutional and enterprise procurement requirements. GSSC pursues exactly that class of client. A document can be visually immaculate and still fail an accessibility review outright, and none of the existing design QA can see it.
required_action: When a tagging-capable tool becomes available -- Chrome DevTools Protocol tagged-PDF export, Acrobat Pro, or a Python tagging library -- extend this module to a full PDF/UA gate and supersede this text. Until then the source floor is the guarantee and the gap is stated, never implied closed.
failure_modes: Asserting PDF/UA conformance that no tool in the pipeline can produce
Dropping lang, title, or alt in a future template edit
Treating a passing Section 45 run as evidence of PDF accessibility
Adding an unlabelled inline SVG figure
